quotes.text: Schedule changes—rescheduling or cancellation—are handled by updating or deleting the relevant Appointment resources.
All FHIR operations are executed in real time throughout the simulation.

parsed.rationale: Actions that create, update or delete Patient and Appointment records are named and said to execute against the FHIR server (optional in the README). The agent-visible prompts do not say writes are executed or simulated. The rubric scores schedule correctness, but no penalty for unsafe or unnecessary writes is described.
